basis_translation.auger_energy_basis: E^2 = p^2 + delta_gamma2 E^4 + (delta_gamma4_iso + delta_gamma4_I6 I6) E^6 + O(E^8)
basis_translation.mapping_scope: leading EFT series through sixth order only
basis_translation.series_identity: E^4 = p^4 + 2 c p^6 + O(p^8), so delta_gamma2 = c and delta_gamma4 = d - 2 c^2; the isotropic c leaves the I6 coefficient unchanged

conditional_bound.coefficient_scope: photon-only special branch with zero electron and positron LIV coefficients and ordinary additive conservation
